days.title: Summit Experience and National Park Views
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kitzsteinhorn
stops.detail: The Kitzsteinhorn is part of the Glockner Group located in the Hohe Tauern and reaches a height of 3203 m above sea level.

stops.name: Top of Salzburg
stops.detail: On the roof of the station there is a viewing platform called "Top of Salzburg".

stops.name: Glückauf-Hanna-Stollen
stops.detail: Starting from the summit station, one can reach a second viewing platform with a view of the Hohe Tauern National Park, passing among other things through the 362-meter-long Glückauf-Hanna-Stollen tunnel.

stops.name: Nationalpark Gallery
stops.detail: Since then, the tunnel – as well as the second viewing platform – has been referred to as the "Nationalpark Gallery".

stops.name: Schmiedingerkees
stops.detail: The Schmiedingerkees can have open crevasses and may make crampons or, in extreme situations, a rope belay necessary.
